name: flow-inline-validation
title: Inline Validation
description: Rời ô Email sang ô mật khẩu, viền ô Email chuyển màu cảnh báo và dòng báo lỗi mở ra ngay bên dưới, đẩy ô mật khẩu xuống.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Email field 180x36 r8 with a blinking caret, Password field below. Cursor clicks the password field at 0.5 s: the Email focus ring fades out 0.1 s, its border turns warning (accent yellow) 2 px, and a message row opens below it: clip height 0 → 28 px with opacity 0 → 1 over 0.5-1.12 s power2.out, icon circle r6 '!' + text dropping 4 px; the Password field moves down 28 px and takes the focus ring. Reverse 2.3-2.6 s power2.in. Params: height (28 px) · duration (0.62 s) · color (vàng cảnh báo) · ease (power2.out). Leaving the field turns its border to the warning colour and opens the message row (0.62 s power2.out), pushing the next field down; reversed at 2.3 s with power2.in.
